entries.title: rules
answers: Which rules do you want? I know the chat rules, account rules, hacking rules, voting rules, alt account rules, payment rules and donator rules. You can also ask for the punishment of something, like "punishment for tp killing".
Which ones? I have the chat rules, account rules, hacking rules, voting rules, alt account rules, payment rules and donator rules. Just say the name, like "chat".

entries.answer:
I have two versions of the chat rules, so here are both.

Chat rules, list 1:
- English only in public chat, other languages in DMs [warn/mute 5-15min]
- No spamming letters or repeated phrases [warning/mute 15m-2h]
- Swearing is allowed, but not at other players [warning/mute 30m-2h]
- No making fun of mental or physical disorders [warning/mute 30m-2h]
- Respect others, don't annoy people on purpose [warning/mute 45m/ban 15m]
- No politics or religion in chat [warning/mute 15m-60m]
- No advertising other servers, including naming them [mute/IP ban]
- No begging for rank, fly, coins and so on [warning/mute 30m]
- No disrespecting staff [warning/mute 30m-1d]
- No leaking personal information [mute 1-7d/IP ban]
- No racism or discrimination [mute 1h-3d]

Chat rules, list 2:
- No insults or offensive language, even phrased as questions [mute 30m-2h]
- No bringing up a player's personal life or family [mute up to 5d]
- No provoking others to break rules [mute 30m-60m]
- No begging for anything (rank, coins, unban, unmute) [mute 30m-1h]
- No spam or flooding, 3+ messages [mute 20m-60m]
- No impersonating staff [mute 12h-1d]
- No racism, religious, political or ethnic hate [ban 2d-5d]
- No misleading other players [mute 30m-60m]
- No lying to staff or faking conversations [ban 1h-1d]
- No commercial activity with real money [permanent ban]
- No advertising other servers or scams [permanent ban]
- No threats to players or staff [ban 5h]
- No insulting the server [ban 2d]
- No insulting or provoking staff [ban up to 7d]
- No doxxing or leaking personal info [ban up to 10d, then permanent]

Account rules:
- Your account is your responsibility. It can be punished whether it was you or not.
- Selling or sharing your account is strongly prohibited [ban FOREVER + account reset]
- Impersonating another player or staff is prohibited [warning/ban 1w/ban forever]
- Inappropriate usernames (offensive, political, religious) [ban forever]
Selling or sharing your account is strongly prohibited [ban FOREVER + account reset]. Accounts that were shared before the rule was added (05/03/2024) can be an exception.

Hacking, texture pack, auto clicker and illegal activity rules:
- No hack clients, cheat texture packs (X-Ray) or auto clickers installed [ban 1d/ban forever]
- No weight or tape to hold down your mouse [warning]
- No macro scripts for interval commands or auto joining [warning/ban 1d]
Voting rule: using a VPN to vote more than once every 24 hours, for an alt or the same account, is not allowed [warning/ban 1-5d + reward reset]. Vote at mineberry.org/vote.
If you have a punishment and use an alternative account to enter the server, the alt gets a full ban and your current ban is extended if it isn't permanent already.

Payment rules:
- Strict no refund policy, because ranks and items are digital intangible items
- A chargeback or any legal action against the server bans all your accounts [IP ban FOREVER + account reset]
- If the payment went through but you did not get your goods, contact staff with the receipt that was emailed to you
There is a strict no refund policy, because the ranks and items are digital intangible items. The store checkout is run by Tebex, who handle billing support and refunds.
Issuing a chargeback or any form of legal action against the server bans all your accounts [IP ban FOREVER + account reset].

If the payment went through but you did not get your goods, contact staff with the receipt that was emailed to you after the purchase. You can also ask in the MineBerry Discord: https://mineberry.org/discord

Donator command rules:
- No offensive prefix, suffix or nickname, and no politics, religion or race in them [warning/ban 1w]
- No using donator perks to damage or lag the server or players [ban 5d/ban forever]
Ranks, rank upgrades, crate keys and coins carry over in a reset. Grant Reset (in Miscellaneous) does not carry over.
Coins are a currency for perks, items and other things. Spend them in the Coin Shop with /coinshop.
Crate keys unlock crates in game at /crates. Each crate has different chances to win rewards. Left-click a crate in game to see the possible rewards.
Ranks give you money, blocks and EXP, plus a permanent rank on your account. Ranked players get daily kits, useful perks and commands. Click a package in the store to see what is in it.

You must already own the first named rank for an upgrade to work. Always double-check before buying an upgrade. Buying an upgrade without owning the first rank isn't swapped for the full rank anymore, unless the rank you want costs the same or less (staff, 19/04/2026).

entries.answer:
IRL trading is not allowed, and advertising or promoting it isn't either. Paying real money for balance, coins, keys, ranks or rankups, or trading them for items in other games (robux included), gets all players involved banned, and staff actively look for it.
Trading balance, ranks, rankups or crates for each other, or ranks and rankups for coins, is only punished when someone reports it with proof. Then both players are banned and the seller gets the longer ban.
First time is a temporary ban. Repeat attempts are a permanent ban with no appeal.
entries.title: irl trading

entries.answer: Rank transfers have been paused indefinitely (staff post, 15/01/2026). When they were open, a rank could only move between alt accounts of the same player. Check #faq on the Discord if that changes.

If your account is linked to Discord: use /account resetpassword to get a new password, then change it with /changepass [old_pass] [new_pass] in game.
If it isn't linked: use /passreset in the Discord or fill in the password reset form. Staff compare the IP you give with the one the account was registered with, and forms are checked about once a week, so it can take days. Send it once, extra forms get deleted.
Staff never ask for your password.
entries.title: password reset

entries.answer:
Once your account is linked to Discord you can use these commands (in the account-link channel or in DMs with the bot):
- /account listnames: shows all linked accounts
- /account ban lobby: bans your own account from the server
- /account unban: unbans it (only if you banned it yourself)
- /account kick: kicks your account from the server
- /account resetpassword: sets a new password
- /unlink: unlinks the account
- /2fa enable, /2fa disable, /2fa notifyjoin: 2FA and join notifications
To unlink you need access to the Discord account it is linked to. Never share your link code, staff will never ask for it.
entries.title: account linking

keywords: will staff ask for my password
entries.answer:
Staff, mods and owners never ask for your password or link code. Real staff only message you from their main Discord accounts, and identity is checked by IP through the forms.
Don't join IPs that strangers give you. Fake MineBerry servers steal passwords, and the official IPs are shown with /ip. Don't click links or accept free nitro, rank or coin offers either, those are stolen accounts. Report anyone who asks for your password or link code, and change your passwords if you got hacked.
entries.title: scams and hacked accounts

entries.answer: Can't connect but others can, or the ping is bad? Try eu.mineberry.org. It's the most optimized one and often helps players from Asia. The official IPs are shown with /ip.

Top 5 monthly voters get a reward 1-7 days after the leaderboard resets, which is the last day of every month. If everyone else got theirs and you didn't, you probably weren't in the top 5. If nobody got it, contact the moderators.
The only way to become a mod is to apply while applications are open, they are announced in #faq. Sometimes players are invited for outstanding activity, a clean history and helping others.

Appeals go to the mod who banned you. Ask who it was and ping them only if they haven't replied in over a day.
Bans for hacking can't be appealed. The anti-cheat can misfire sometimes, but its bans aren't lifted, you have to wait them out, unless someone is clearly being targeted for their ping.
entries.title: appeals and anticheat bans

entries.answer:
Scamming for a rank-up isn't allowed, but the server doesn't settle deals that involve real money (ranks, rankups, coins). Since 21/05/2026 those trades are banned anyway, see "irl trading". Rule 7.1 is for in-game item scams in /ah or promised trades that weren't completed by both players.
If a mod agrees, you can ask them to be your middleman in a trade. If you can't find one, keep solid proof of every transaction.
Trolling is allowed, but if someone asks you to stop, you must stop. Annoying players on purpose or abusing commands like kick or warn is abuse and isn't tolerated.

Impersonation includes changing a single letter of a name and using prefixes like "Mob" or "Stuff", because it still confuses newer players. Impersonating a player or staff: warning/ban 1w/ban forever.

Any family insult counts under chat rules 1.3 and 1.5, even as a joke: mute 3d-30d depending on severity and how often. Insulting someone for their nationality is racism (1.11) and starts at a 7d mute. Racism has zero tolerance, the first offence is a 7d mute in game.
Framing other players or faking information or proof to get them banned gets you banned instead. On Discord you're banned from the server, and if your username is known you're banned in game too.
Using admin chat (/emsg) while muted counts as mute bypassing. The ban is as long as the original mute, even if only a couple of hours were left (staff post from 2024).

The Chunk Collector is a craftable item that works like a hopper but collects items from the whole chunk. It only works for the region it's placed in, and staff recommend it over normal hoppers because it's much lighter on the server. F3+G shows the chunk outline.
Every Survival server has an end warp. The end islands were cleared and claimed, with pvp disabled at the centre, so the dragon fight is safe.

Known bug (Oct 2026): coins can go to the opposite game mode from the one you picked, for example Survival ends up on Anarchy. They transfer to the right one once it's fixed, updates come in #faq.
Negative balance after buying fast in /coinshop: take your time when buying there. The best fix is buying coins in the online store, or selling in /coinmarket if the bug doesn't affect you.
Sell something on your alt account for the amount you want to move, on the MK in Anarchy, then buy it from Survival with your main account. About 20% is lost to tax, so list 1000 to end up with 800.

entries.answer: Claim land with /rg claim. Your rank sets how many regions you get: Silver 2, Supreme 4, Wither 6, Hero 8, Avenger 50, Legend 99, Phoenix 299, Ender 999. entries.title: claiming land

entries.answer: Set a home with /sethome. How many you get depends on your rank: Silver 2, Supreme 4, Wither 6, Hero 8, Avenger 50, Legend 99, Phoenix 299, Ender 999. Don't set homes near other players' regions to kill them, that's a ban.
entries.title: homes

entries.answer: Ask a player to teleport to you with /tpahere (Silver and up). Spawn and warps are the other ways around. Using teleports to trap or kill players (tp killing, warp killing) is a ban.

Ranks come with a kit, like /kit silver or /kit legend. Open the rank's package in the store to preview what's inside.
entries.title: kits

entries.answer: Silver and above can open their enderchest anywhere with /ec.

Playing earns you money: Silver gets 50$ every 5 minutes, up to 600$ for Ender. Selling on the Auction House (/ah) works too. Real money trades with other players are not allowed.
Buy coins in the online store (store.mineberry.org) and spend them in the /coinshop. Trading coins for real money is not allowed.
